_: Lane model and effort pairings, ordered L1 (most capable) to L7 (cheapest). The sibling host table uses the same reasoning tiers.
$comment_skill_supports_effort: Whether this harness accepts an effort key in SKILL.md front matter. Codex does not, so a Codex skill payload gets the rung's model alone and the rung's effort reaches it only through a lane agent.

L1.summary: Critical analysis, deep architectural research, and consequential design decisions.
L1.why: The strongest reasoning for critical analysis, deep research and consequential design with interacting constraints.

L2.summary: Difficult bounded analysis or judgement requiring careful reasoning.
L2.why: Careful reasoning for difficult bounded analysis, diagnosis, design or review.

L3.summary: Open investigation or bounded uncertain design.
L3.why: General reasoning for open investigation and bounded uncertain design.

L4.summary: Specified implementation, ordinary review, and small local testable choices.
L4.why: the workhorse family at high effort. Specified implementation and ordinary review, including a small local mechanism choice inside a testable fix. Features, bugfixes and review lenses whose mistakes a compiler or a test suite will catch. Delivery never selects this rung.

L5.summary: Mechanical work whose shape is already decided.
L5.why: the small family at high effort. Mechanical work whose shape is already decided: scripted edits, docs, ledger upkeep.

L6.summary: Bulk clerical work whose input is too large for the cheapest rung.
L6.why: the small family at medium effort. Clerical loops and bulk passes -- a monitor, a long transcript, a big diff -- that outgrow the floor rung.

L7.summary: Clerical work with a small input and no judgement to make.
L7.why: the small family at low effort. In-session clerical work with a small input: commit, push, pull, sync, one poll. Handoff launchers reject this rung.

$comment_context_ceiling: null means unrecorded, not unlimited. The Claude table carries real per-model windows from the published model table; the Codex figures are not verified here, so recording a number would be inventing one. A lane consumer that needs a ceiling must treat null as 'unknown' and not assume the input fits.
